fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) carry the article page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block spread close to verbatim; latest-mode records (S2-atom, from Vox's site-wide Atom feed) carry title/link-style fields. Extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may also appear since upstream JSON-LD is not filtered.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (article URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld for articles, S2-atom for latest headlines, or 'none' on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/dek (article-mode), or the Atom entry's HTML-escaped teaser summary (latest-mode).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full plain-text article body, as emitted directly in the JSON-LD block (confirmed full-text, not paywall-truncated, on sampled articles).

author.title: Author
author.description: Article-mode: array of author objects (name + profile url), raw passthrough from JSON-LD. Latest-mode: single author name string from the Atom entry's <author><name>.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher organization object, raw passthrough from JSON-LD (typical NewsArticle field).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image object, raw passthrough from JSON-LD (typical NewsArticle field).

mainEntityOfPage.title: Main entity of page
mainEntityOfPage.description: Canonical WebPage reference, raw passthrough from JSON-LD (typical NewsArticle field).

articleSection.title: Section
articleSection.description: Article vertical/section (e.g. the-highlight, podcasts, future-perfect, politics).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords as emitted in the JSON-LD block (shape varies -- string or array).

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Upstream paywall metering flag -- observed false on every sampled article despite articleBody being full-text (soft/cosmetic paywall marker, same pattern as LA Times).

speakable.title: Speakable
speakable.description: Text-to-speech CSS selector hint block, raw passthrough from JSON-LD (schema.org noise, not a first-class field for this actor's purposes).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the Atom feed entry (latest-mode).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, from the Atom entry's <link rel="alternate"> (latest-mode).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of <category term="..."> tag values from the Atom entry (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
